method.samples: fresh processes, cases run serially round-robin
method.warm: discard first API and plugin call in each process
method.cache: distinct seeds 1..calls: fast-layout seed; Graphviz start
method.api: outermost function span containing one plugin call, includes encoding and decoding
method.plugin: call plugin trace span, excludes outer Typst encoding and decoding
method.output: blank one-page PDF; assert 100 positions and no Graphviz layout error
method.scope: fast-layout returns positions; Graphviz also handles node sizes and edge routes; budgets and quality are not matched

untraced_check.method: One additional fresh process per case with the identical five-call document, without --timings. Whole-process times include the first call; these are not the warm-call table values.
